tool.name: Amazon Q Developer
tool.description: AWS coding assistant whose IDE plugins and paid subscriptions reach end of support on April 30, 2027; AWS steers new users to Kiro.
tool.pricing: $19/user/mo Pro for existing subscribers only; closed to new signups.
tool.logoNotes: Official AWS architecture icon for Amazon Q (`Arch_Amazon-Q_64.svg` from the AWS Architecture Icons pack), intentionally reused because AWS presents these surfaces as Amazon Q variants rather than with separate public per-variant icons.
tool.practitionerNote: Do not start new rollouts. Existing AWS-heavy teams should plan the move to Kiro (IDE/CLI) before April 2027, and to AWS Transform for Java/.NET upgrade work.

dataResidency.detail: Pro tier stores in the profile region; free tier defaults US East; EU inference kept in EU.

deployment.detail: SaaS via IDE plugin / AWS console; no self-hosted option.

auditLogging.detail: All Pro API calls logged via CloudTrail; configurable S3 delivery.

soc2.detail: Amazon Q Developer in scope for AWS SOC 1/2/3.

iso42001.detail: AWS ISO 42001 scope names Q Business/Bedrock/Textract/Transcribe; Q Developer not explicitly listed.

euAiAct.detail: Assessed limited-risk by product category; no published vendor EU AI Act conformity assessment.

tool.statusNote: Announced April 30, 2026: new signups blocked from May 15, 2026 and IDE plugins plus paid subscriptions end support on April 30, 2027. Amazon Q in the AWS console, docs, and Slack/Teams chat is unaffected.
